verdicts.evidence: Code trace: MobileApp.tsx:477 snapshots draftId from capture at Save; :627 `mintedHere = !editingId && !draftId` uses that snapshot inside the queued write; enqueueWrite (:168-174) serialises B after A, so by the time B runs A's POST resolved and A's addLines PATCH landed in D, and ensureDraftId (:467-483) returns the same memoised D. B's PATCH failure then hits :667-673 -> deleteOrder(D) (no check that another line confirmed into D) and clears draftId. Backend DELETE (orders/lifecycle.ts:62-160) collects order_lines.scan_image_id + order_line_photos.storage_key, deletes the order (lines cascade) and deleteAttachments() from R2. Uploaded photos are dropped from the client buffer on success (lib/linePhotos.ts flush: setPending keeps only failed), and submitOrder (:771-813) -> buildOrderSubmit (lib/orderSubmit.ts:70-78) takes the `create` path with toAddLine, which carries scanImageId (:65) but no photos and no carry plan (unlike the merge path's planCarry). Harness: docs/review-2026-10-31/repro/A7-verify/stale-minted-here.test.ts models the queue/ensureDraftId/mintedHere closure verbatim and calls the real buildOrderSubmit: `npx vitest run --root docs/review-2026-10-31/repro/A7-verify` -> 1 passed (asserts D deleted, Submit req.kind=create, line A scanImageId still 'orders/D/scanA.jpg').
verdicts.reason: The stale-snapshot mintedHere makes a failed second save delete a draft that already holds a confirmed line; A's line is recreated on Submit but its photos are lost and its scan key points at a deleted R2 object. Not rendered end to end (no jsdom/testing-library in apps/frontend and pnpm install is forbidden), so the harness mirrors the component closure rather than mounting MobileApp. The window is narrow (B must be saved while A's draft POST is still pending, and B's PATCH must then fail), but the outcome is silent loss of user photos in a supported flow, so P2 stands.
